summary: Pickett County, TN tower listed standing by Tennessee Landforms and on a 2014 National Register list; a Komoot summit page gives a lower elevation; no build records found.

facts.status_note: Tennessee Landforms lists it as standing, and a 2014 National Register list of towers standing on March 26, 2014 includes it. No later check of its condition was found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Tennessee Landforms gives 1,642 feet (500.5 m); the Komoot summit listing gives 480 m, about 20 m lower. The record keeps the Landforms figure because it is the value in the tower list, and the story reports the Komoot figure as a disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Two sources plus one summit listing. Two searches found no build date, designer, staffing or fire record for Regan Knob, and the Forest Lookouts and NHLR Tennessee indexes do not list it. Do not confuse with the Pickett State Park tower (see data/research/us-tn-pickett-state-park.json). The 2014 list also has a separate tower named Pickett, listed under Fentress County. The Landforms code 4-5 is not explained on the page. The Komoot page does not mention a tower. Confidence is medium only for identity, county, the Landforms elevation and the 2014 listing.
